nativeIdentityProof.interpretation: Archival replay loader/test changes leave the expanded native reviewer assets, gate identity, execution identity and all registry hash axes unchanged.

reserve.interpretation: All source and qualifications are investigator-exposed. Reviewer outcomes for this reserve remain unread until the candidate implementation, assets and settings are frozen. This is outcome-protected regression confirmation, not source-unseen or independent human ground truth.

runPolicy: No quality-selected retries, --against, or --fail; resume incomplete technical work only under identical identities. Initial --fresh follows private archival of the aborted ledger.
decision: Report every paired transition on the frozen set and reserve; do not trade a bug-detection regression for a cleaner headline. An improvement claim requires improved clean acceptance with no lower observed bug detection, separately disclosed on the reserve. Uncertainty and non-improvement are reportable results.
